subject: Researchers map how single neurons assemble spoken language
script: From Agewell Brief: Researchers map how single neurons assemble spoken language. Recordings from eight people revealed how individual neurons tracked grammar, meaning, and sentence context during natural conversation. The work maps part of language production at cellular scale; it does not read private thoughts or demonstrate a speech prosthesis. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
